dct_description_sm: These data were collected opportunistically during a cruise of the CCGS P. Radisson from Kuujjuaripik, PQ, to the estuary of the Nelson River. The primary reason for the expedition was recovery and redeployment of ArcticNet oceanic moorings in SE and SW Hudson Bay.  This data serves to supplement a data record began previously in Hudson Bay in continuing University of Manitoba studies of freshwater-marine interactions in Hudson Bay. These studies include freshwater sources (fluvial and ice-melt), distribution and circulation in Hudson Bay and Hudson Strait, nutrient and sediment loading from two major rivers (the Nelson River and the Rivire de la Grande Baleine), and optical effects of CDOM (colored dissolved organic matter) and sediments on the littoral of Hudson Bay.
dct_subject_sm: Natural sciences -> Colored dissolved organic material (CDOM)
dct_title_s: Water quality in southern Hudson Bay, autumn 2011
